browserSuite.browser: Installed Microsoft Edge, headless Chromium engine on Windows

navigationTimeout.test: Tray pointer close stays in its scene after reopening settles
navigationTimeout.cause: Not established; isolated unchanged rerun passed. Do not call the final full run clean or infer a confirmed production tray defect.

architecture.traveler: One persistent mascot, viewport-derived story geometry
architecture.renderer: SVG joints containing progressively cached, cropped, predecoded approved artwork partitions; no live masks after cache readiness
architecture.macro: ScrollTrigger with smoothed scrub and time-based hero entrance; curved Bezier/cosine travel
architecture.secondary: Shared GSAP ticker, elapsed-time life, staggered damped springs, independent 470ms arrival
architecture.web: Dynamic animated hand socket, short directional fixed anchors, speed-dependent sag, retract before reattach
architecture.bottle: Separate existing prop, free-hand web, overshoot, diminishing pendulum, about 1.3s visibility, 1.53s complete
architecture.dashboard: Real captures plus matching illustrative live SVG ring/counters and shallow depth
architecture.lowPower: Approximately 30Hz life on mobile/save-data/<=4 logical processors
architecture.reducedMotion: No cinematic travel, pinning or cursor parallax; controls/readable states preserved
architecture.hiddenCleanup: Life ticker removal; owned timelines paused; media/page disposal releases resources
architecture.cache: One-time browser canvas work, shared idle/happy cache, abort pending jobs and revoke blob URLs on teardown; immediate pose selection and SVG fallback during caching; resolution follows CSS maximum mascot size and DPR, capped at 1000 pixels (440 at DPR 1)
architecture.refresh: Suspend story-state selection between refreshInit and completed refresh; rebuild from final geometry

review.performance: Final capture records initial/warmed idle and scroll RAF distributions with cached pose counts. No physical-device 60FPS certification.
review.manualAcceptance: Review continuous motion and frame pacing on intended recording hardware; Safari/Firefox and physical weaker hardware remain manual.

frameIntervals.scenario: Headless browser RAF intervals, no video encoding; not a physical-device certification.
